newsitem.title: UK: NWE bunkers firm on lack of avails, Med flat.
newsitem.headline: NWE bunkers firm on lack of avails, Med flat.

text.p: Bunker prices in northwest Europe remained firm on Thursday on a shortage of product, dealers said.
Rotterdam bunkers were steady after heavy demand earlier in the week, with 380 cst at $88/89 a tonne and 180 at $94.
"There's not a lot of product around. That is one reason why prices have gone up," one dealer said. She put volume at about 10,000 tonnes.
Prices rose in Hamburg, where 380 cst increased to $93/95. "There are sufficient avails. The market is hectic with firm prices," another dealer said.
In the Mediterranean, however, prices were broadly flat and trading was quiet.
In Durban, dealers said the tanker replenishing Richards Bay had broken down and one described the supply situation at the port as "a disaster". Cape Town remained tight.
